item.title: 2025 AKC NOHS Invitational
item.description: It’s time for our annual NOHS recap, covering the pros and cons of not just the NOHS Finals in Orlando, but of the year as a whole. I am grateful that each year this article gets shorter, as the system and shows continue to iron out problems.

item.title: Westminster’s Canine Celebration Awards 13th Annual Masters Agility and 2nd Annual Flyball Tournament Champions
item.description: Yesterday, The Westminster Kennel Club welcomed nearly 500 dogs to its Canine Celebration, held at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center.
